MADHUSMITA PADHIARY Finance Accountant | Financial Data Analyst | Reconciliation | Derivative trader & Arbitrageur +91- 7894159164 lovelyguddy96@gmail.com www.linkedin.com/in/madhusmita-padhiary-85862320a Noida

Summary

Over 6.4 Years of experience as Finance - Accountant,Financial Data Analyst, Derivative Trader, back office executive. Work on daily client operations in different asset classes like Equity, Derivatives, Fixed Income, Swaps, and Private Equity. Manage daily and monthly reconciliation of the Client's portfolio. Working in different types of strategies in the derivatives market and generating profit for the company while working as a Derivative trader/Arbitrageur. Handling all types of financial work while working as a Back office executive.

Skills

Financial Reporting Reconciliation General ledger Fund Accounting Analytical Skill Troubleshooting SQL Financial Analysis

Experience

State Street Corporation [Process Migrated from Ameriprise India LLP]. Finance Accountant

Noida, India

10/2025 - Present

Lead end-to-end reconciliation process for multi-asset portfolios, ensuring accurate alignment between internal records and J.P. Morgan

custodial files across cash, positions, and transactions.

Identify, analyze, and resolve complex breaks; investigate root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions to minimize recurrence. • Reviewed and validated complex financial instruments including equities, fixed income, FX, and derivatives to ensure accurate NAV reporting and accounting integrity.

Ensure all reconciliations are completed within established SLAs and comply with regulatory and audit standards. • Highlight high-risk breaks and escalate issues impacting NAV accuracy. • Manage month-end close activities and handle custodian processes, including trade/settlement matching, cash and position verification, and query resolution with JPM.

Monitor corporate actions and income posting (dividends and interest) to ensure accurate booking. • Experience using FIS Invest One accounting tool and FIS Control Center tool to reconcile data. • Successfully supported end-to-end process migration from Ameriprise to State Street Corporation with zero operational disruption. • Ensured seamless transition of NAV, reconciliation, and custodian processes, maintaining 100% delivery timelines during the transition phase. • Played a key role in stabilizing operations post-transition and acted as a key contributor in knowledge transfer, ensuring smooth handover and process continuity.

Performed trade enrichment by validating and enriching trade attributes including settlement instructions, broker details, account information,

instrument reference data, and trade economics before downstream processing.

Worked on SSI (Standard Settlement Instructions) validation and maintenance to ensure accurate settlement routing and minimize settlement failures. • Utilized Duco for automated cash, trade, and position reconciliations, investigating unmatched items and driving timely resolution of reconciliation exceptions.

Utilized TLM (Transaction Lifecycle Management) for reconciliation monitoring, exception management, and operational break resolution. • Conducted pre-upload validation of trade files, ensuring data completeness and accuracy before processing into downstream fund accounting and portfolio management systems.

Performed STP break investigation by identifying trade, cash, and position exceptions, analyzing root causes, and coordinating with internal teams, custodians, and counterparties for resolution.

Supported post-trade operations including trade confirmation validation, trade enrichment, settlement validation, and post-trade reconciliation to ensure timely processing across multiple asset classes.

Validated trade capture, amendments, cancellations, and settlement instructions across Equities, Fixed Income, FX, OTC Derivatives, and Private Equity instruments.

Worked closely with custodians, fund administrators, and counterparties to resolve trade matching and settlement exceptions within defined SLAs. • Supported SWIFT-based settlement operations by validating settlement instructions, monitoring trade settlement messages, coordinating with custodians, and resolving settlement exceptions to ensure timely processing

Nirvana Solutions India Pvt Ltd. Financial Data Analyst

Gurugram, India

06/2022 - 12/2023

Experienced Financial Data Analyst with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services industry. Skilled in team management,

reconciliation, reporting, hedge fund accounting, new client onboarding/integrations, internal audit, and management.

Consolidates and manages data across multiple asset classes, funds, accounts, traders, prime brokers, and custodians in a single integrated

platform and reporting solutions.

Oversees daily, monthly, and quaterly reconciliation of trade, position, and cash covering a wide range of asset classes (equity, derivative, fixed

income, FX).

Reviews and maintains daily trade activity, implements dividend/corporate actions in the portfolio, and prepares portfolio reports and other

regular financial statements for clients.

Analyzes and implements data for corporate actions like ticker change, spin-off, split, reverse stock split from Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, E-

Signal, and Dividend Investor.

• Managed daily trade processing across multiple asset classes including equities, fixed income, OTC derivatives, FX, and private equity investments. • Performed trade capture validation by reviewing executed trades, validating trade attributes, and ensuring accurate portfolio updates before downstream

processing.

• Supported the complete trade lifecycle from trade capture through reconciliation, settlement validation, corporate action updates, and NAV reporting. • Performed pre-upload validation of trade, position, and cash files before system processing to ensure data integrity and minimize downstream reconciliation

breaks.

Investigated STP breaks by performing root cause analysis on trade, position, and cash exceptions and coordinating with custodians and internal teams for timely resolution.

Worked with custodians and fund administrators to validate trade settlement status, cash movements, and position balances across global markets. • Supported new fund onboarding and migration activities including reconciliation validation, UAT execution, and production readiness testing. • Delivered NAV reports to stakeholders with a focus on accuracy, compliance, and transparency, supporting fund performance evaluation and investor confidence.

Participates in new fund/custodian onboarding and system migration testing to ensure seamless integration with clients. • Participated in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and system migration projects to validate functionality and ensure seamless client transitions. • Possesses knowledge of private equity fund accounting such as capital call, LC, GP, LP, funds of funds, distress equity, venture capital, LBO, etc. • Has strong knowledge of capital markets, trade lifecycle, OTC derivative products, and settlement processes. • Provided training and mentorship to new hires on finance, company domain, and workflow processes, enhancing team productivity.

Experience

Divya Portfolio Pvt Ldt. Arbitrageur/ Derivative Trader

Ghaziabad,India

11/2019 - 12/2021

Analyze Indian Market Nifty, Bank Nifty and trade in the market according to market trends. • Work in different types of derivative strategies in the Indian Market. • Invest company-provided funds in the Indian Market and generate profit for the company. • Manage risk while trading in the market. • Have working experience in trade capture, trade amendments, and PnL & position calculations for future and option trades. • Implement robust risk management practices, including hedging strategies, to safeguard capital against market volatility. • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced trading environment with high attention to detail. • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. • Strong communication and collaboration abilities to work effectively with cross-functional teams. 01/2017 - 02/2019

Analyze Indian Market Nifty, Bank Nifty and trade in the market according to market trends. • Work in different types of derivative strategies in the Indian Market. • Invest company-provided funds in the Indian Market and generate profit for the company. • Manage risk while trading in the market. • Have working experience in trade capture, trade amendments, and PnL & position calculations for future and option trades. • Implement robust risk management practices, including hedging strategies, to safeguard capital against market volatility. • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced trading environment with high attention to detail. • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. • Strong communication and collaboration abilities to work effectively with cross-functional teams. 01/2017 - 02/2019

Managed and recorded all financial transactions with accuracy, ensuring compliance with internal policies and statutory requirements. • Prepared and published monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements within strict deadlines, supporting management decision-making and regulatory reporting.

Oversaw the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes, ensuring completeness and accuracy of accounts. • Conducted detailed account reconciliations for accounts payable and receivable, identifying discrepancies and implementing corrective actions. • Monitored and maintained balance sheets, profit and loss statements , providing clear visibility into company performance. • Stayed updated on changes in accounting standards, tax regulations, and financial reporting requirements, ensuring compliance and timely adoption of new practices.

Education

Fakir Mohan University BA (Economics Hons.)

Balasore, Odisha

05/2013 - 05/2016

Internship & Certifications

The 6-month internship program at the Institute of Career in Financial Market (ICFM,Delhi) with professionals having all- around knowledge of Technical Analysis, Equity & Derivatives, and Indian Markets.

March 2019 to Sep 2019

Certified NISM: Series VIII

National Institute of Security Market

English Proficient

Hindi Proficient

Odia Native
